title: Magic's Planeswalker series comes to Netflix in 2027
summary: Netflix revealed PLANESWALKER on November 13, 2026: an animated Magic: The Gathering series centered on Chandra, premiering in 2027.

facts: Netflix and Wizards of the Coast revealed PLANESWALKER, an animated series based on Magic: The Gathering, on November 13, 2026.
The series premieres on Netflix in 2027.
The story centers on Chandra, a volatile pyromancer hunted for her gifts, alongside some of the most legendary Planeswalkers.
Terry Matalas is showrunner, Cindy Appel co-showrunner and Patrick Osborne supervising director.
Animation is by the studio Digic, with Hasbro Entertainment among the producers.
details.why: Magic's first big streaming series puts Chandra and the Planeswalkers in front of a whole new audience.

title: Riftbound bans Riven, Dazzling Aurora and more
summary: Riftbound's Radiance ban list adds eight cards and two battlefields to Standard and 2v2 Constructed, effective Monday, November 23, 2026.

facts: Announced November 13, 2026; the bans take effect Monday, November 23, 2026, in Standard and 2v2 Constructed.
Eight cards are banned: Riven, Broken Blade; Zhonya's Hourglass; Stellacorn Herder; Nocturne, Horrifying; Rhasa the Sunderer; Brynhir Thundersong; Dazzling Aurora; and Baited Hook.
Two battlefields are banned too: Emperor's Dais and Star Spring.
Riven made up 43% of decks at the European Regional Championship and took 3 of the top 4 spots.
Korea and Traditional Chinese regions aren't affected until Radiance releases there; from 2027, bans come in set windows around each Continental.
details.why: Riven, Kennen and Kai'Sa decks all lose key cards, so the competitive meta resets before December's North America Regional Championship.

title: Pokémon Day 2027 Collection lands January 29
summary: The Pokémon Day 2027 Collection reaches stores January 29, 2027, with a stamped foil Pikachu promo, three booster packs, a coin and a TCG Live code card.

facts: Pokémon Day 2027 Collection releases January 29, 2027 (The Pokémon Company International).
It includes a specially stamped foil Pikachu promo card.
Also inside: three Pokémon TCG booster packs and a collectible coin.
A code card for Pokémon TCG Live comes in the box.
Pokémon Day itself is February 27, 2027.
details.why: A new stamped Pikachu promo is a yearly collector favourite, and it lands a month before Pokémon Day.

title: Magic's Star Trek is out; To Boldly Go league starts
summary: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek releases November 13, 2026, and the To Boldly Go sealed league runs in stores through January 28, 2027.

facts: Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek is in stores today, November 13, 2026.
To Boldly Go is a Sealed league at WPN stores, running November 13, 2026 to January 28, 2027.
Players start with six Star Trek Play Boosters and can add more boosters as they rank up.
Play three games at Starfleet Academy, then explore four quadrants (Alpha, Beta, Gamma and Delta), each with its own rules.
Every three matches in a quadrant earns a rank pip; reaching Captain earns a league promo card.
details.why: It's a casual, months-long way to play the new set at your local store, with a promo at the end.
